subject: One-off zero-cost pilot & sandbox extension for Lexicon Health — exec approval needed
messages:
From: Ava Roberts <ava@lexicon.health>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lexicon Health Procurement <procurement@lexicon.health>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request — zero-cost pilot quota + sandbox extension

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Lexicon’s integration team has completed the initial connector but the security review timeline has slipped: our InfoSec has requested an additional architecture review and a small penetration verification before we can run scale tests. That pushes our run window past the standard PLG sandbox limits.

We’re asking for a one-off exception: a 90-day extension to the sandbox window and a one-time zero-dollar pilot credit equivalent to 120,000 tokens to complete the scaled inference run (no billing until we sign a contract). Business case in brief: if the pilot validates, Lexicon expects to convert to a production contract with an estimated first-year ARR of ~$300k and a multi-year relationship with EMR integrations.

Attached are: a short SOW, a security scoping workbook, and our PoC acceptance criteria. If you can route this for exec sign off today, procurement will prioritize the PO.

Appreciate your help — happy to hop on a quick call if that helps.

Best,
Ava Roberts
Director, Strategic Integrations
Lexicon Health
[attachment: SOW_Draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 42KB)]
[attachment: security_scoping.xlsx (XLSX, 18KB)]
[attachment: lexicon-poc-requirements.md (MD, 6KB)]

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Request — zero-cost pilot quota + sandbox extension

Marissa / Aditya — forwarding Lexicon’s ask. Key points: 90-day extension requested + one-time zero-cost credit = 120k tokens. Potential ARR ~300k. Security gating is the reason for the slip.

Recommendation (my read): Approve a conditional, one-off package to keep the momentum:
- Grant one-time 120k token credit (no charge to Lexicon)
- Approve a 60-day sandbox extension immediately; consider full 90-day if security signoff scheduled within 10 business days
- Credits are contingent on: signed addendum (legal), PO in 45 days, and security scoping kickoff within 5 business days

Risks: tokens consumed with no conversion if procurement delays; marginal infra cost is low vs lost deal probability. If we approve, I will own the addendum with Legal and Ops.

Can we get CXO sign-off from Rishi on this? I’ve cc’d him for visibility.

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Exec, Strategic PLG
Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Quick approval ask: Lexicon (DEAL-5821) — one-off pilot credit/extension

Rishi — short note with numbers:
- Ask: 120,000 token credit (zero-dollar), plus sandbox extension (recommended 60–90 days)
- Expected upside: ~ $300k ARR in year 1, multi-year upsell on EMR connectors
- Cost to Redwood: expected infra delta ~ $1.5k–$3k for the run (GPU time + network) if consumed fully
- Controls proposed: addendum capturing terms, 45-day PO requirement, security scoping kickoff, and a Go/No-Go milestone at the mid-point

I support Neha’s conditional package. If you prefer tighter guardrails we can shorten to 60 days but still provide the 120k token credit.

Marissa — any additional take?

Thanks,
Aditya Rao
Director, Sales Operations

From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick approval ask: Lexicon (DEAL-5821)

Quick +1 from me. Lexicon moved fast in the demo and the integration team is engaged. If we don’t give them breathing room now we risk losing the window to a competitor. 300k ARR is realistic. We should insist on the addendum + PO timeline.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, aditya_rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Mar 2028 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick approval ask: Lexicon (DEAL-5821) — APPROVED (conditions)

All — after reviewing the notes and attachments I approve a one-time, zero-dollar credit of 120,000 tokens and a sandbox extension. Conditions:
1) Sandbox extension granted immediately for 60 days. We will reassess extension to 90 days only if Lexicon schedules the security scoping kickoff within 10 business days.
2) Lexicon must sign a short addendum prepared by Legal that states credits are one-off and will be invoiced if a PO/contract is not executed within 45 days.
3) Security scoping call scheduled within 5 business days; engineering contact exchanged.
4) If credit consumption exceeds 120k tokens before contractual close, we will pause service and review next steps.

Neha — please coordinate Legal and Ops to create the addendum and confirm the timeline. Marissa/Aditya — please continue to drive procurement.

Good work on the deal — let’s get them to trial success.

Rishi Malhotra
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
